positive_cases.prompt: 从原始 counts 和 metadata 设计 donor-aware bulk RNA 分析。
从 FASTQ 运行已锁定的 bulk RNA 定量和差异表达流程并记录全部输出。
为 10x scRNA 构建含 ambient、doublet、QC、integration、annotation 和 pseudobulk 的代码。
审计 snRNA 对象的 QC、注释和 donor-level DE 是否真的运行。
规划空间转录组 geometry QC、去卷积、空间域和 patient aggregation。
按原命令和环境重跑空间分析并比较 domains 与患者级结果。
把真实 pseudobulk 和细胞丰度结果交给机制解读与写作。
指导学员在资源有限时选择可辩护的空间转录组分析路线，并说明升级条件。
把冻结的 snRNA 工作流和真实结果交给论文写作，限制摘要与标题的主张。

boundary_cases.prompt: 这些单细胞结果能否证明免疫通路导致影像异质性？
integration 和 clustering resolution 的选择是否足以支持结论？
计算 donor-level 差异的 CI 并校正多重比较。
设计敲低和 rescue 实验验证候选通路。
根据已经冻结的单细胞结果写 Results。

invariants: Plans and code drafts are never reported as completed runs
Cells, nuclei, spots, sections, genes, and technical replicates are not independent patients or donors
Donor-sample mapping is frozen before execution
Integrated values and inferred compositions are not measured biology
Protected test data cannot select QC, parameters, methods, seeds, figures, or claims
Every completed run has exact command, environment, log, exit status, and verified artifacts
Computational association or trajectory is not causal proof
FASTQ-to-matrix provenance binds sample sheet, chemistry, reference index, commands, logs, and produced matrix
Imaging-based spatial assays are not forced through a sequencing pipeline
